title.narrative: Decolonisation & anti-racism: Learning curriculum development (Dominican Republic)

description.narrative: Drawing on the findings of the knowledge justice / learning from good practice sub-group, we have identified a number of initiatives to take our knowledge justice work forward. The first of these is a piece centered on organisational learning around decolonisation. The sub-group’s Terms of Reference recommends that we: Devise, develop and establish a mode of delivery for a learning series that has learning outcomes relevant to the whole organisation and is pitched at appropriate levels for a wide range of learners. The series will focus on race, racism, racialisation and decoloniality and the relationships between these and poverty. https://christianaid.sharepoint.com/sites/REL/Shared%20Documents/Research%20and%20evidence/Internal%20Strategic%20Reviews/Knowledge%20Justice%20and%20Learning%20from%20Good%20Practice/LearningTask/DecolonisationCurriculumDevelopmentToRs_Oct2023.docx
